summary: OpenProject is a web-based platform designed for tracking projects, organising tasks, and defining goals. It facilitates team collaboration through work packages and provides integration options with external version control platforms like GitHub.
goodFor: It suits teams requiring a structured, self-hosted environment to manage complex workflows and link project tasks directly to code repositories.
watchOut: As a comprehensive Ruby-based application, it can be resource-intensive to host and maintain compared to lightweight task lists.
deployNotes: You can typically deploy this software using Docker alongside persistent storage volumes for your database and file attachments, fronted by a reverse proxy to handle TLS.
